name: Kern County, CA
findings: Kern County has 1,714 nonprofit organizations. 589 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 442 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kern County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few foundation organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 foundation organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through foundation groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 232 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
